problem: The 2-tuple shim turns (lo, hi) from closed [lo, hi] into half-open [lo, hi), silently changing every public function's results (e.g. (1,1) is dropped, difference loses the upper bound).
parse delegates to reference_impl._Algebra.parse, making production code depend on the reference implementation and blinding any comparison test against it to parsing bugs.
